chapterInfo.content:
1
Wiase adeɛ nyinaa yɛ adeɛ huhuo
1Dawid ba Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, ɔhene a ɔwɔ Yerusalem no nsɛm nie.
2Ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ! Ɔsɛnkafoɔ na ɔseɛ;
ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ! Adeɛ nyinaa yɛ huhuo.
3 # Ɔsɛ 2.22 Mfasoɔ bɛn na onipa nya
ne brɛ a ɔbrɛ owia yi ase nyinaa mu?
4 # Dwom 90.3 Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kɔ, na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ba,
na asase deɛ, ɛtim hɔ daa.
5Owia pue, na owia kɔtɔ,
na ɛyɛ ntɛm kɔ n’afa a ɛfiri pue hɔ.
6Mframa bɔ kɔ anafoɔ fam,
na ɛdane ba atifi fam;
ɛde ntwareho kɔ, na ne ntwareho no so
na mframa no nam sane ba.
7Nsubɔntene nyinaa sene kɔ po mu,
nanso ɛpo nyɛ ma ara da.
Faako a nsubɔntene no nenam korɔ no,
ɛhɔ ara na ɛsane kɔ bio.
8 # Dwom 90.10 Abrabɔ nyinaa mu yɛ ɔbrɛ nko ara;
obiara ntumi nka;
adehwɛ mmee aniwa,
na asɛnteɛ nso nyɛ aso ma ara da.
9Adeɛ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no bɛkɔ so ara awɔ hɔ.
Na biribiara a ayɛ no, ɛbɛkɔ so ara ayɛ;
na adeɛ foforɔ biara nni hɔ owia yi ase.
10Asɛm bi wɔ hɔ a wɔka no sɛ:
Hwɛ, yei yɛ foforɔ anaa?
Tete nteredee berɛ
a adi yɛn anim no so na ɛbaeɛ.
11Nkaeɛ biara nni hɔ mma kane nnoɔma no,
na daakye nnoɔma a ɛbɛba no nso
rennya nkaeɛ biara,
deɛ ɛbɛdi akyire aba no nkyɛn.
12 # Ɔsɛ 1.1 Me ɔsɛnkafoɔ, madi Israel so hene Yerusalem; 13Mede m’akoma mama sɛ mede nyansa bɛbisa na mahwehwɛ nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no ɔsoro ase nyinaa mu, ɔhaw bɔne a Onyankopɔn de ato adasamma soɔ sɛ wɔmmfa mu no. 14Mehunuu nnwuma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase nyinaa, na hwɛ, ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.
15 # Ɔsɛ 7.13 Deɛ akyea no, wɔntumi ntene,
na deɛ ate aka mu no, wɔntumi nkan.
16Me ne m’akoma kasaa sɛ: Me deɛ, hwɛ, mama me nyansa aso ayɛ bebree sene wɔn a wɔdii m’anim Yerusalem nyinaa, na m’akoma ahunu nyansa ne nimdeɛ a ɛdɔɔso. 17#Ɔsɛ 2.12; 7.25 Na mede m’akoma nyinaa hwehwɛɛ sɛ mɛhunu nyansa, na mahunu adammɔ ne nkwaseasɛm, nanso mahunu sɛ yei nso yɛ dadwene hunu.
18Na nyansa dodoɔ mu wɔ ɔhaw dodoɔ,
na deɛ ɔtia nimdeɛ no ti awerɛhoɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Dawid ba Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, ɔhene a ɔwɔ Yerusalem no nsɛm nie.
Ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ! Ɔsɛnkafoɔ na ɔseɛ;
ahuhudeɛ mu ahuhudeɛ! Adeɛ nyinaa yɛ huhuo.
Mfasoɔ bɛn na onipa nya
ne brɛ a ɔbrɛ owia yi ase nyinaa mu?
Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ kɔ, na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ba,
na asase deɛ, ɛtim hɔ daa.
Owia pue, na owia kɔtɔ,
na ɛyɛ ntɛm kɔ n’afa a ɛfiri pue hɔ.
Mframa bɔ kɔ anafoɔ fam,
na ɛdane ba atifi fam;
ɛde ntwareho kɔ, na ne ntwareho no so
na mframa no nam sane ba.
Nsubɔntene nyinaa sene kɔ po mu,
nanso ɛpo nyɛ ma ara da.
Faako a nsubɔntene no nenam korɔ no,
ɛhɔ ara na ɛsane kɔ bio.
Abrabɔ nyinaa mu yɛ ɔbrɛ nko ara;
obiara ntumi nka;
adehwɛ mmee aniwa,
na asɛnteɛ nso nyɛ aso ma ara da.
Adeɛ biara a ɛwɔ hɔ no bɛkɔ so ara awɔ hɔ.
Na biribiara a ayɛ no, ɛbɛkɔ so ara ayɛ;
na adeɛ foforɔ biara nni hɔ owia yi ase.
Asɛm bi wɔ hɔ a wɔka no sɛ:
Hwɛ, yei yɛ foforɔ anaa?
Tete nteredee berɛ
a adi yɛn anim no so na ɛbaeɛ.
Nkaeɛ biara nni hɔ mma kane nnoɔma no,
na daakye nnoɔma a ɛbɛba no nso
rennya nkaeɛ biara,
deɛ ɛbɛdi akyire aba no nkyɛn.
Me ɔsɛnkafoɔ, madi Israel so hene Yerusalem; Mede m’akoma mama sɛ mede nyansa bɛbisa na mahwehwɛ nnoɔma a wɔyɛ no ɔsoro ase nyinaa mu, ɔhaw bɔne a Onyankopɔn de ato adasamma soɔ sɛ wɔmmfa mu no. Mehunuu nnwuma a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase nyinaa, na hwɛ, ne nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.
Deɛ akyea no, wɔntumi ntene,
na deɛ ate aka mu no, wɔntumi nkan.
Me ne m’akoma kasaa sɛ: Me deɛ, hwɛ, mama me nyansa aso ayɛ bebree sene wɔn a wɔdii m’anim Yerusalem nyinaa, na m’akoma ahunu nyansa ne nimdeɛ a ɛdɔɔso. Na mede m’akoma nyinaa hwehwɛɛ sɛ mɛhunu nyansa, na mahunu adammɔ ne nkwaseasɛm, nanso mahunu sɛ yei nso yɛ dadwene hunu.
Na nyansa dodoɔ mu wɔ ɔhaw dodoɔ,
na deɛ ɔtia nimdeɛ no ti awerɛhoɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
